title: Edge failure indicator
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and assign each vertex a label from the $q$-element alphabet. For a vertex $v$ and a neighbor $w$ of $v$, the edge failure indicator is $0$ if the constraint permutation on $(v,w)$ sends $w$'s label to $v$'s label, and is $1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game G with alphabet size q
A label from the q-element alphabet at each vertex
